basic_info.description: Step into San Francisco history at 2914 Folsom Street one of the storied Folsom Ladies, a rare row of 1870s Italianate Victorians. Blending historic soul with modern functionality, this Inner Mission gem offers period details, a remodeled kitchen, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The main home features 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, a sunroom, and a lush garden with built-in grill and brick patio perfect for entertaining. High ceilings, original millwork, and natural light create timeless appeal.      A detached 1 BD/1 BA ADU above the 2-car side-by-side garage (accessed via Horace Street) adds flexibility for guests, rental income, or multi-gen living. Steps from 25th Street's vibrant dining, nightlife, and culture, 2914 Folsom delivers historic character, modern convenience, and true Mission vibe in one rare offering.
